notes.ai: AI can monitor, score, and report only. AI cannot mint, change balances, change consensus, or alter supply.
notes.founder: Founder/main allocation is 5% total: 1% liquid and 4% locked/vesting. Final founder wallet address binding is required before mainnet.
notes.mainnet: Any mainnet economy change requires explicit final review before launch.
notes.nft: NFT review/mint flow cannot change QC supply, QC balances, mining rewards, or consensus.
notes.status: Pre-mainnet economy control only. This does not launch mainnet.
notes.supply: Total supply is fixed at 25,500,000 QC.
notes.testnet: Testnet may test logic but cannot override mainnet economic invariants.
notes.tgwt: TGWT is off-chain/game ecosystem accounting and cannot mint QC or change QC supply.
